Fiesta Bowl Game Day Overview

Held at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, the Fiesta Bowl is one of college football's premier postseason games:

  • Venue: State Farm Stadium (72,000+ capacity)
  • Location: Glendale, 20 miles from Scottsdale
  • Traffic: Expect 2-3 hour delays without planning
  • Parking: Limited and expensive

Why Book Transportation

Beat the Traffic

Professional drivers know the approach routes, timing strategies, and exit plans that get you home faster than driving yourself.

Tailgate in Comfort

Our vehicles offer climate-controlled pre-game preparation. No standing in parking lots—arrive refreshed and ready for kickoff.

Post-Game Escape

While others wait in parking lot gridlock, our pickup coordination gets you on the road within 30 minutes of leaving your seats.

Vehicle Options

Fan Groups (6-10)

Sprinter vans accommodate fan groups with team gear, coolers, and comfortable seating for the excitement.

Large Groups (15-40)

The Party Bus (28 Pax) and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach handle alumni groups, corporate outings, and extended fan families.

Executive Service (2-6)

SUVs provide premium game day experience for smaller groups or VIP entertainment.

Pricing

  • Luxury SUV, up to 6 (6 hours): $750
  • Executive Black Sprinter, up to 14 (6 hours): $870
  • Party Bus (28 Pax) (8 hours, 7 billed): $1,750

Prices are before 8% Arizona sales tax. Every rate is on the pricing page.
